chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Bilal, who said:

There came out to me from Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام, two years before his passing, informing me of the successor after him. Then, three days before his passing, there came out to me informing me of the successor after him.

key_terms.أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ: Abū Muḥammad, the kunyah of Imam al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْخَلَفِ: the successor who comes after, referring here to the succeeding Imam
key_terms.بِثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ: three days before the stated event
key_terms.بِسَنَتَيْنِ: two years before the stated event
key_terms.مُضِيِّهِ: his passing away or departure from this world

ai.seo_question: How did Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام indicate the Imam who would succeed him?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام informed the narrator, on two occasions before his passing, about the successor after him. It serves as a textual indication toward the succession of the Imam after him and is cited in the context of establishing the Imamate of the Master of the Age عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Bilal who said,

‘There came out to me from Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) before his<sup>asws</sup> passing away by two years informing me of the replacement (Imam<sup>asws</sup>) from after him<sup>asws</sup>. Then there came to me from before his<sup>asws</sup> passing away by three days informing me with the replacement (Imam<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>asws</sup>)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Bilal who has said the following.

“Two years before his leaving this world, abu Muhammad (a.s.)sent out information to me about the succeeding Imam after him. Just three days before his leaving this world he again sent out information to me about the succeeding Imam after him.”
